blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) formally turned over a Patient Transport Vehicle (PTV) to the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) on October 5, 2026, to strengthen its patient transport capabilities and support its medical, humanitarian, and emergency response operations. The turnover ceremony was led by PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles, together with PCSO Chairman Judge Felix Reyes (Ret.), Directors Janet Mercado, Jennifer Liongson-Guevara, and Imelda Papin, and Assistant General Manager for Charity Sector Atty. Lauro Patiag. The vehicle was officially received by PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil Gavan. The donation is part of the Medical Transport Vehicle Donation Program (MTVDP) of […]...
